items.summary: AWS announces that Claude Haiku 5.5, Anthropic's Haiku-tier model, is available on its platform.
items.whyItMatters: If you build on AWS, a new small Claude option is available without changing providers.

items.summary: OpenAI announces GPT-6 together with an interface update it calls Intelligent UI, aimed at all ChatGPT users.
items.whyItMatters: A new flagship generation changes which model you test against and which behaviors you can rely on.
items.trendReason: Flagship launch covered across the lab, press and newsletters; the source count understates reach.

items.summary: A newsletter roundup says Claude Haiku 5.5 beats GPT-6 Luna at the same price. It is a secondhand comparison of two small models.
items.whyItMatters: Price-performance in small models drives many production choices; verify the comparison on your own tasks.

items.summary: The Verge reports that ChatGPT answers now include pictures, charts and buttons as part of an interface update.
